basis: Authored application-policy expectations before workflow implementation. Source scope is the unchanged, pinned pearl-milling-2025-v2 fixture. These are synthetic confirmations, not reports of real physical actions.

guards.identical_initialization: No reset, duplicate tasks or events
guards.identical_evidence_replay: No new version, duplicate tasks or events
guards.identical_confirmation_replay: Return original receipt; do not add quantity or events
guards.reused_confirmation_id_with_changed_payl: Reject and audit; no state mutation
guards.stale_inventory_version: Reject and audit; no action completion
guards.stale_recall_version: Reject and audit; no action completion
guards.wrong_stock_group_or_unit: Reject and audit; no action completion
guards.quantity_exceeds_remaining: Reject and audit; no action completion
guards.nonpositive_or_noninteger_quantity: Reject and audit; no action completion
guards.confirmation_on_inspection_or_review_tas: Reject and audit; no action completion
guards.inventory_update_after_partial_confirmat: Preserve old receipt and supersede old open hold task; new version requires its own confirmation
guards.ambiguous_new_code: Identification unresolved; replace inspection with review, do not mark inspection done
guards.excluded_new_code: Identification evidence resolved; exclusion remains a review proposal, no hold confirmation or release
guards.model_fabricates_confirmation: No tool or argument exists that can record it
guards.event_update_or_delete: SQLite rejects mutation of append-only history
